reason: A DSH integration bundle that connects the official Wolfram AgentTools MCP server, discovers and supervises a local Wolfram kernel, exposes Wolfram tools, and routes side-effecting calls through DSH approval policies.

summaries.zh: 将官方 Wolfram AgentTools MCP Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供内核发现、进程监督、Wolfram 工具注册及 DSH 原生审批策略。
summaries.en: Connects the official Wolfram AgentTools MCP server to DeepSeek Harness with local kernel discovery, process supervision, tool registration, and DSH-native approval policies.

capabilities: Connects DSH to the Wolfram AgentTools MCP server
Discovers and launches a local Wolfram kernel process
Exposes Wolfram tools for arbitrary code evaluation, testing, notebook reading and writing, code inspection, and symbol metadata
Applies approval decisions to tool calls through DSH policies
Manages and terminates the Wolfram process tree started by the plugin
